newsitem.title: MEXICO: Bufete says natgas plant to be Q3 backlog.
newsitem.headline: Bufete says natgas plant to be Q3 backlog.

text.p: Construction company Bufete Industrial SA de CV will enter a 242 million peso contract for a cryogenic natural gas processing plant under backlog in its third-quarter earnings report, a company spokesperson said on Thursday.
"We signed the contract on... (September 27).... We'll enter it under backlog for the third quarter," said a spokesman for Bufete's deputy CFO.
Bufete announced earlier on Thursday that Pemex Gas and Basic Petrochemical divisions had awarded it the 242 million peso contract.
Bufete's backlog totalled 3.004 billion pesos at the close of the first half of 1996, down from the year-ago figure of 3.220 billion pesos.
The new plant will supply areas affected by the explosion of Pemex's Cactus processing plant in the southern state of Chiapas.
